editorial:
Imagine waking up in a world where the laws of society just stop working. You are dropped right into a gritty, dirty part of Taiwan where a man with a knife makes the rules. This movie is a Cat III film, which means it is meant for adults only because it gets very messy and dark. It follows a main character who is caught in a cycle of violence and greed, surrounded by people who have completely lost their way. The vibe is heavy and uncomfortable, making you feel like you are trapped in a nightmare where nobody is safe and the air is thick with tension.

What really hits home is how the actors make you feel the desperation of their characters. The pacing is slow at first but then it ramps up into total chaos. You will love the raw energy, but be warned that some parts are hard to watch because they are so mean.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart in the final act when the violence reaches a boiling point. The main characters face the consequences of their cruel choices in a bloody showdown. You see that nobody really wins in this world; the cycle of pain just keeps spinning. The movie ends with a grim realization that the butcher is just a product of a broken society. It wraps up with a cold, dark feeling that leaves you thinking about how far people will go for power.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves raw and uncensored underground cinema.
